name: KaroStartup

sources.title: Homepage — active Indian startup newsroom; dozens of stories dated 2026-09-24/25/26 incl. founder profiles and clearly sponsored-style PR posts
Get in touch — 'Promote your startup, send us a tip, advertise...' form with inquiry-type tabs and direct emails
Batch-provided URL — 404/redirects away; the live contact hub is /contact

requirements: Indian startup/business angle strongly preferred — the newsroom covers Indian startups, funding, founders, fintech, D2C
Submission channels on /contact: tabs for 'Promote Your Startup', 'Advertise', 'Send a Tip', 'PR / Press', 'Partnership', 'Careers', 'General'
No published rate card on the contact page — 'promotion inquiries hear back within 24 hours', so promotion is a sales conversation
preparation: A press-release-ready story: company, what launched/raised, location, quotes, dates — the site publishes verbatim-style PR posts
Founder name/photo and company details for founder-profile pitches
Decide the lane: free 'Send a Tip' for editorial coverage vs paid 'Promote Your Startup'/'Advertise'
Contact form needs name, email, phone, subject, ≥30-char message (max 2000)
workflow: Pick the right tab: 'Send a Tip' for a free editorial shot, 'Promote Your Startup'/'Advertise' for paid placement, 'PR / Press' for release distribution
Submit the form or email business@karostartup.com directly
If accepted, the story appears as a dated article on karostartup.com like the daily feed
watchFor: Batch URL /advertise-with-us is dead — everything routes through /contact
The feed mixes editorial with obvious paid PR ('ITPracticeTests.com Offers 50% OFF...', app-review promos) — placement may be paid-only in practice
No rate card published; pricing is negotiated per inquiry
Non-India products are a weaker fit but the PR stream is broad
countsAsLive: A dated article about the startup/product appears on karostartup.com's article feed with its own permalink
unknowns: Whether 'Send a Tip' yields unpaid coverage or all placements are paid
Whether articles include a followed link to the company
